task:
Produce a SMALL, COMPLETE, APPLY-CLEAN CHARACTER COMBAT PATCH for src/game/Character.js only. Output ONLY one canonical unified diff beginning exactly with `diff --git a/src/game/Character.js b/src/game/Character.js`. No prose, no Markdown fences, no ellipses, no omitted context, no new files. The patch must be complete enough for `git apply --check` to pass. Keep the patch under roughly 120 changed/added lines.

DO NOT rewrite _build(), _animate(), _attackPose(), geometry/material creation, leveling, or unrelated rendering. Touch only the constructor's combat state fields plus beginAttack(), beginDodge(), update(), attackWindow(), and at most tiny private combat helpers if absolutely necessary. Preserve every existing public interface and keep Game.js runtime-compatible without requiring edits in this pass.

Goal: make Character's action state more coherent without broad cleanup. Keep state/stateTime/stateDuration/comboIndex as the presentation authority. Give the 3 sword swings explicit startup/active/recovery boundaries encoded compactly; exactly one attackWindow() event per swing; stable facing during active frames; combo-specific forward commitment; sensible late-recovery dodge cancellation with explicit i-frames; clean return to idle. Preserve current durations/balance approximately, with hit 3 clearly heavier/longer. Do not attempt to move Game's input buffer/combo ownership yet—that is a separate pass.

Favor the smallest robust implementation that materially improves feel and is easy to review. Before emitting, mentally verify every hunk against the supplied exact file and ensure the diff is not truncated.
